summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Srishti Gupta, MD MPP as CEO and board member, effective July 1, 2026, succeeding Xi-Yong (Sean) Fu who resigned as CEO and board member effective June 30, 2026, without disagreement. Additionally, directors Emmett T. Cunningham, Jr. and Sean Cao resigned, and President Mark Hagler resigned to remain CCO. No price, premium, or share terms are involved. The changes are immediate with no regulatory clock. Watch for any strategic shifts under new leadership.
